articles.summary: SOMERSET, N.J., April 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Legend Biotech Corporation (NASDAQ: LEGN) ( Legend Biotech), a global leader in cell therapy, will host a conference call for investors at 8:00 am ET on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, to review first quarter 2026 financial results.
articles.title: Legend Biotech to Host Investor Conference Call on First Quarter 2026 Results
